title: Global ML Lounge Chair
body_html:
A minimalist lounge chair that brings quiet, contemporary polish to any reception or waiting area.

The Global ML Lounge Chair is a contemporary take on classic minimalist style, designed by Richard Eppstadt for reception areas, modern offices and hospitality settings. Upholster it in COM or the full range of Global textiles and leathers, and pair a metallic or painted frame finish in Black, Chrome, Brushed Chrome, Designer White or Tungsten. Built in Canada and tested to exceed ANSI/BIFMA standards, it coordinates with the wider ML family of sofas, stools, dining chairs and a matching ottoman.

Key features

  • Contemporary minimalist lounge chair designed by Richard Eppstadt
  • Coordinates with a full ML family: dining chairs, two- and three-seat sofas, bar stools and a matching ottoman
  • Upholstered in COM or the full range of Global textiles and leathers
  • Choice of metallic and painted frame finishes: Black, Chrome, Brushed Chrome, Designer White, Tungsten
  • Tested to exceed ANSI/BIFMA standards in an ISO 17025 certified facility

Who it’s for

Reception areas, modern private offices and hospitality-style waiting spaces in municipal, education and healthcare environments that want a refined, design-forward lounge seat.

Office Central and Brant Business Interiors are verified OECM partners, so Ontario’s public sector can buy without an open tender. Call 1-800-835-9565 for a quote.
